name: YouTube Music Download Helper
author: y-exe
description: Matches a track's title, artist and length against YouTube Music's official catalog — searching in the song's own script — and saves its original AAC/M4A audio.
changelog: 1.0.8: Matching fixes: Latin, Greek and Cyrillic accents fold before comparison (Cariño/Carino, Noo Phước Thịnh/Noo Phuoc Thinh), edition notes like (Remastered 2011) and (Album Version) are cut from both titles, and an artist written in another script than the catalog counts when title and length already match (Odeya/עודיה, Mayday/五月天, 藤井 風/Fujii Kaze). Name order (UTADA HIKARU/Hikaru Utada), $-stylings (KE$HA/Kesha) and soundtrack notes in the search queries are absorbed too.

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Find download audio among YouTube Music's official songs

actions.name: network
actions.why: Search songs, get audio URLs, check them
